{{Top|leg}}
'''Trevi City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevi IV]]. The initial settlement was established by [[Truishii]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. [[Fiz Cor'gril]]'s business, ''[[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]]'', was located in Trevi City.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)}}</ref>
